certifications.title: SomNOG9 Cybersecurity Workshop & Tutorials
certifications.description:
Successfully completed the **SomNOG9 Cybersecurity Workshop**, held from **19–21 September 2026** at **Somali National University, KM4 Campus, Mogadishu**. The three-day practical cybersecurity track was designed for final-year students, fresh graduates, and early-career ICT professionals, with approximately **60–70% hands-on learning** in an authorized isolated lab environment.

The workshop covered **cybersecurity foundations, networking for security, Linux security, reconnaissance and footprinting, network scanning and enumeration, vulnerability assessment, web application security, penetration testing, SOC operations, SIEM, threat analysis, incident response, risk mitigation, and basic digital forensics**. Practical exercises introduced tools and technologies including **Nmap, Wireshark, OWASP Juice Shop, Metasploit, Linux security utilities, KQL, and Wazuh**.

The training also included **CTF competitions, controlled security testing, attack analysis, and defensive security exercises**, providing practical exposure to real-world cybersecurity concepts and operational security practices.
